info.name: Kanmon Public V2 Bank Accounts Payments API
Fetch payment schedule for an issued product

params.name: drawRequestIds
params.description: A comma delimited list of Kanmon’s unique draw request IDs.

params.name: invoiceIds
params.description: A comma delimited list of Kanmon’s unique IDs for invoices.

params.name: platformInvoiceIds
params.description: A comma delimited list of your platform’s unique IDs for invoices.

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of records to skip when performing pagination. Defaults to `0`.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of records to limit when performing pagination. Defaults to `100`, which is the max.

items.docs: Deprecated. Prefer Fetch payment intents (`getPaymentIntents`) instead.

params.name: ids
params.description: A comma delimited list of Kanmon’s unique payment intent IDs.

params.name: invoiceIds
params.description: A comma delimited list of Kanmon’s unique IDs for invoices.

params.name: drawRequestIds
params.description: A comma delimited list of Kanmon’s unique IDs for draw requests.

params.name: issuedProductIds
params.description: A comma delimited list of Kanmon’s unique IDs for issued products.

params.name: businessIds
params.description: A comma delimited list of Kanmon’s unique IDs for businesses.

params.name: triggers
params.description:
A comma delimited list of payment intent triggers to filter by.
DISBURSEMENT Funds disbursed to the business.
DISBURSEMENT_RETURN Return of previously disbursed funds. Only relevant for some AP financing setups.
SCHEDULED_REPAYMENT A repayment scheduled on the payment schedule.
EARLY_PAYOFF An early payoff of outstanding principal and interest. Early payoffs will cancel remaining scheduled repayments for installment products once they settle.
REFINANCE_PAYOFF A bookkeeping record to pay off existing principal as part of refinancing into a new loan agreement.
FEE A fee charged to the business, such as a maintenance or transaction fee.
REFUND A refund or rebate issued to the business.
MINIMUM_PAYMENT A minimum payment, relevant only for Integrated MCA products.

params.name: cancelled
params.description: When true, return only cancelled payment intents. When false, return only non-cancelled payment intents.

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of records to skip when performing pagination. Defaults to `0`.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of records to limit when performing pagination. Defaults to `100`, which is the max.

items.docs: A payment intent represents a planned payment on an issued product, such as a disbursement, scheduled repayment, fee, or refund. It tracks intended amounts, whether the payment is late, settlement progress via the confirmed and pending amount fields, and the payment orders that actually move funds. Payment intents may be cancelled when superseded — for example, by an early payoff.
